clue.text: Number on watch?

parts.note: a figure printed round a clock face, or one of the numerals lit up on a ... wristwatch, is the kind of number meant

explanation.surface: A question about the figures shown on a wristwatch.
explanation.definitionFit: A single numeral from nought to nine is a figure of that kind, and a digital watch shows its time in them.

clue.text: One with relatives in the Home Guard initially, is on the march

indicators.note: the word 'in' places the one-with-relatives pieces inside the opening letters that follow
initially tells us to take only the opening letter of each of Home and Guard

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
kin means one's family or relatives

explanation.surface: A family member in the wartime Home Guard sets off marching.
explanation.walkthrough: The Home Guard was Britain's volunteer defence force in the Second World War. 'initially' gives HG, and I plus KIN go inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone tramping across country on foot is out walking, much as soldiers are when they march.

clue.text: Unlucky place for William as things turned out

indicators.note: turned out suggests the letters of the two words are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: Things went badly for a man called William at some location.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned out' rearranges AS THINGS. The town in Sussex gave its name to the 1066 battle fought by William the Conqueror.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sussex town is the site of the famous 1066 battle where William of Normandy fought Harold.

clue.text: Supporters of persistent horses

definitions.meaning: stays are props or supports, so things that hold something up
racehorses that keep going over long distances

explanation.surface: Backers of racehorses with plenty of stamina.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses come from 'stay': to prop up, and to last the distance in a long race.

clue.text: Type of table only used in Autumn?

definitions.text: Type of table only used in Autumn?

parts.words: Type of table only used in Autumn?
parts.note: the season when the leaves fall from trees is played against a table whose hinged flaps hang down

explanation.surface: A question about a piece of furniture that comes out in one season.
explanation.definitionFit: A table with hinged flaps that hang down when not in use; in autumn, tree foliage also falls.

clue.text: Angle for defence in Dyfed

definitions.note: the definition names a place found in the Welsh county, so it stands for a town there

parts.note: to angle is to go fishing
a guard is a defence or protection

explanation.surface: A Welsh angler trying out a defensive stance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Angle' looks like a noun, but it is the verb meaning to fish. Dyfed was a Welsh county, now Pembrokeshire and neighbours.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pembrokeshire harbour town lies in the old Welsh county, the ferry port for Ireland.

clue.text: Self-appointed watchman leaving it in a bad way

indicators.note: something in a bad way is in disorder, so the letters are jumbled into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A guard walks off the job, leaving things in a mess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a bad way' rearranges LEAVING IT.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who takes on the job of policing a neighbourhood without any official authority.

clue.text: Railway assistance for a capital band

definitions.note: capital means first-rate, so a fine strip of trimming

parts.note: BR is British Rail, the former national railway
aid means help or assistance

explanation.surface: Rail travel helps a top-notch musical group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'band' looks like a group of musicians, but here it is a strip of trimming; 'capital' means excellent, not a city.
explanation.definitionFit: A woven strip of thread used as trimming, here called excellent, is a decorative strip of material.

clue.text: Bliss of oriental study

parts.note: oriental means eastern, abbreviated E
a den is a private study or room

explanation.surface: The happiness found in an eastern room.
explanation.definitionFit: The garden of paradise in Genesis stands for a state of perfect happiness.

clue.text: Service to make small cars go

parts.note: the Mini is a famous small British car
a go is an attempt or try

explanation.surface: A garage job that gets little cars running.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go' is the noun, as in 'have a go'.
explanation.definitionFit: A government department, or the work of a priest, is a branch of public service.

clue.text: Exercise in rude shed (innermost parts)

indicators.note: in places the exercise inside the rearranged letters of shed
rude means rough or crude, so the letters of shed are roughly shaken up

parts.note: PT is physical training, school exercise

explanation.surface: Someone does a workout in a rough garden shed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rude' rearranges SHED into DEHS, and 'in' puts PT inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The deepest or most remote regions of something are its farthest inward reaches.

clue.text: The countryman's against a single drink

parts.note: a single means one, so the letter A
gin is an alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: A rural man refuses a single glass of spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The countryman's' marks the definition as a rustic dialect word.
explanation.definitionFit: A dialect form of the preposition meaning opposed to, as a rustic would say it.

clue.text: Fell-racer who never wins?

parts.note: a competitor in a hill race on the fells who always finishes second, just behind the victor

explanation.surface: A hill runner with a losing streak.
explanation.walkthrough: A fell is a hill or moor in northern England; fell-running is racing over them.
explanation.definitionFit: The competitor placed second, just behind the winner, never takes first prize.

clue.text: Parisienne worker finds somewhere to eat on motorway

indicators.note: on means the eating place is added on after the motorway, so it comes second

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's first main motorway, written MI
a dinette is a small dining area

explanation.surface: A Frenchwoman stops at a motorway café.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 runs from London to Leeds; crosswords write it MI.
explanation.definitionFit: A young Paris shop assistant or seamstress, especially in the fashion trade.

clue.text: Missouri area, perhaps, where we'd go astray in fog

indicators.note: in places the jumbled letters inside the word for fog

parts.note: mist is a thin fog

indicators.note: going astray means wandering off course, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Travellers get lost in foggy weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go astray' rearranges WED (from WE'D) into DWE, and 'in' puts it inside MIST.
explanation.definitionFit: The central northern US region includes states such as Missouri; 'perhaps' marks an example.

clue.text: But not the actor in the sole part

definitions.text: But not the actor in the sole part

parts.words: But not the actor in the sole part
parts.note: a performer with a tiny non-speaking role is not a real actor; the role is also played on the feet, which have soles

explanation.surface: Not the star who plays the only role.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sole' sounds like the main role but means the underside of a foot, which a stroller uses.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer with a small part on stage and no lines is an extra, not a speaking actor.

clue.text: Georgia's passion can have several elements in it

definitions.text: can have several elements in it
definitions.note: the definition describes a domestic heater with heating elements, standing in for the noun

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia, plus 's
fire means passion or fervour

explanation.surface: A Southern woman's fervour holds many qualities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'elements' suggests chemistry, but it is the glowing parts of a heater.
explanation.definitionFit: A domestic heater burning fuel from the mains has glowing radiant parts.

clue.text: Description of Wells, we hear, bursting into tears in front of Ian

indicators.note: in front of places the jumbled letters before the name
bursting breaks the word tears apart so its letters fall into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone breaks down crying in front of a man called Ian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bursting into' rearranges TEARS to ARTES, set 'in front of' IAN. Wells is also a cathedral city in Somerset, hence 'we hear'.
explanation.definitionFit: A bore-hole where underground water rises by its own pressure is called this kind of well.

clue.text: Summary to the point and spot on

parts.note: a précis is a summary
E is east, a compass point

explanation.surface: A brief summary that is relevant and accurate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to the point' looks like part of the definition, but 'the point' is E.
explanation.definitionFit: Something exact or accurate is correct in every detail.

clue.text: Fellow in Hamlet, say, who has a beer after 6.50?

indicators.note: after places the beer behind the numerals

parts.note: Roman numerals VI for 6 and L for 50
lager is a kind of beer

explanation.surface: A man in Shakespeare's play has a drink just before seven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hamlet' looks like the play but is a small settlement.
explanation.definitionFit: A resident of a small rural settlement lives there.

clue.text: Gun-point opening

parts.note: gat is slang for a gun
E is east, a compass point

explanation.surface: Being held up at gunpoint.
explanation.definitionFit: A hinged barrier in a fence or wall gives a way through.

clue.text: Ship's biscuit for this change of course

definitions.meaning: hard ... is the dry biscuit eaten at sea
to sail on a zigzag heading

explanation.surface: A sailor's biscuit leads to a change of heading.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard rations at sea, and a sailing manoeuvre turning a ship's bow through the wind.

clue.text: Credit reduced-bad deal in the first place

parts.note: credit cut short gives the abbreviation CR

indicators.note: bad suggests the letters of deal are spoiled into a new order

explanation.surface: A poor financial deal leads to a credit rating being cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges DEAL to ADLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A baby's bed is a figurative birthplace, the starting point of something.

clue.text: Was it changed by diet?

indicators.note: changed shows the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether their weight loss was down to dieting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' rearranges WAS IT; the whole clue also describes the part of the body a diet slims.
explanation.definitionFit: The narrow middle of the body is what shrinks when someone slims.

clue.text: Bond agent

parts.note: looks like James Bond, the spy, but means a substance that binds things together

explanation.surface: A secret agent like James Bond.
explanation.definitionFit: Builders use this grey powder mixed with water to bind bricks and stone.

clue.text: eg. Selkirk players on opponents' ground

parts.note: the cast are the players in a show
a team playing away is on its rivals' pitch

explanation.surface: A Scottish town's team plays an away fixture.
explanation.walkthrough: Alexander Selkirk was a sailor marooned on a Pacific island, said to be the model for Robinson Crusoe. Selkirk is also a Scottish town.
explanation.definitionFit: A marooned sailor left alone on an island fits the man stranded for four years.

clue.text: Condescend to Kate Hardcastle's attitude

definitions.meaning: to deign to do something beneath oneself
Kate Hardcastle is the heroine of Goldsmith's play She ... to Conquer

explanation.surface: Lowering oneself to adopt a stage heroine's manner.
explanation.definitionFit: To lower oneself is to deign; the heroine of Goldsmith's comedy bends low to win her man.

clue.text: Start his tables turning

indicators.note: turning shows the letters of the phrase are turned around into a new order

explanation.surface: A man flips his tables over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' rearranges HIS TABLES.
explanation.definitionFit: To found or set up something is to begin it.
